class.name: Hitbox3D
class.brief_description: Active damage detector: an Area3D attached to an attack that scans for Hurtbox3D receivers.
class.description: The Hitbox3D is attached to an attack (a sword swing, bullet, or explosion). It scans the physics space for Hurtbox3D receivers and carries the attack's damage metadata ([member damage], [member knockback], [member damage_types], [member element], [member source]). When it overlaps a Hurtbox3D, it forwards the hit via [method register_hit], which calls Hurtbox3D.apply_hit and emits [signal hit] with the standard hit-data dictionary. Monitoring is on and monitorable is off: attacks are detectors, not targets. A hurtbox is only detected when its collision layer is in this hitbox's [member collision_mask]. Each hurtbox is hit at most once per activation; call [method reset] to re-arm for a new swing.

members.member: Array of StringName damage type tags (e.g. [code]"fire"[/code], [code]"pierce"[/code]).

method.name: build_hit_data
method.description: Builds the standard hit-data dictionary from this hitbox's attack data.

method.name: register_hit
method.description: Registers a hit against a hurtbox: forwards to the hurtbox via Hurtbox3D.apply_hit and emits [signal hit]. Called automatically on overlap; callable directly for scripted attacks.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears the already-hit set so the hitbox can hit again (new swing).

signal.name: hit
signal.description: Emitted when this hitbox registers a hit against a hurtbox.
